description: handleStructuredAuthRequest for /v1/auth/discord/callback (shell/index.ts:292-296) passes an empty string for clientSecret when calling exchangeDiscordCode: `clientSecret: ''`. The config interface at line 267 defines discordClientId and discordRedirectUri but does NOT include discordClientSecret. When the mock is replaced with a real Discord API call, this will silently send an empty client_secret to Discord's token endpoint, causing a 401 from Discord. The config type should include discordClientSecret to prevent this at the type level. The behavioral spec REQ-AUTH-011 requires DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET as a mandatory env var, but the handleAuthRequest config interface does not propagate it.
